subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers accept the July 5 live reports as enough to start a maintainer-owned root-cause pass, or require raw journal/trajectory artifacts before sponsoring code work?
rationale: The report is strong and current-release reproducible, but the source owner is not isolated and automation should not pick between lifecycle, lock, and recovery-surface fixes without maintainer proof direction.

options.title: Sponsor live root-cause pass
options.body: Use the reporter and AS76 live session IDs/logs to isolate the stuck lifecycle or tool-output path before opening a fix PR.

options.title: Require raw artifacts first
options.body: Keep this issue in needs-info until redacted journalctl, trajectory, and session JSONL files are attached or privately provided to maintainers.

options.title: Scope recovery surface first
options.body: Prioritize an operator/admin reset or tools_status surface while tracking the underlying blank-result root cause separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor live root-cause pass
recommendation.body: Use the reporter and AS76 live session IDs/logs to isolate the stuck lifecycle or tool-output path before opening a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent session-lock and gateway restart work makes this the strongest routing candidate for deciding proof sufficiency and owner path.
